lines.text: Moses tells Israel to set apart three cities and build roads so any manslayer can flee to them.
A man who kills his neighbor accidentally when an axe blade flies off the handle may flee to a city.
If the LORD enlarges Israel's territory and Israel keeps the commandments, they are to add seven more cities.
If a man who killed his neighbor out of hatred flees to a city, the priests must bring him back to the avenger of blood.
A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses, since a lone witness is not sufficient.
